text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Sustained paragraphs with developed examples like “lying is a worst trait” and “the difference between Joker and Batman”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"This captures how fully an essay expands its points with supporting explanation and illustrative examples."},{"evidence":"Longer, more connected sentences using transitions like “although,” “even though,” and “in conclusion”","quality":"sentence elaboration","description":"This captures the ability to build and connect ideas across clauses and sentences rather than relying on brief, repetitive statements."},{"evidence":"Argument extended across multiple paragraphs with rebuttal and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"This captures clearer overall structuring of the response into introduction, body development, counterpoint, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"Varied vocabulary such as “trustworthy,” “consequences,” “influences beyond our control,” and “proud of ourselves”","quality":"lexical range","description":"This captures a broader and more flexible word choice to express ideas more precisely."},{"evidence":"Mostly readable despite errors like “it depends on our” and “our it depends on our own selves”","quality":"control of language","description":"This captures better overall command of grammar and phrasing even when mistakes are present."}]}
